candidate.text: The option to run a synchronous probe using `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported, and is now a hidden option that returns the results of the most recent cached probe. It will be removed in a future release.

evidence.excerpt:
* The option to run a synchronous probe using `cilium-health status --probe` is no longer supported,
  and is now a hidden option that returns the results of the most recent cached probe. It will be
  removed in a future release.
